1.m_mDesc: "After taking a certain amount of DMG, Little Bella No. 13 immediately enters a Charging State. This state can be interrupted by dealing strong DMG to her within a short period. While Charging, Little Bella No. 13 takes reduced Non-CRIT DMG. Deploying Vassals who can deal steady CRIT DMG is recommended."

2.m_mDesc: "Little Bella No. 13 gained special protection: Non-CRIT DMG Taken -{0}, CRIT RES Rate +{1}, and CRIT DMG Down +{2}."
